chapterPurpose: ‘Some Unique Places’ is treated as an inquiry-based learning unit. The chapter connects distinctive Indian landscapes, wildlife and habitats, place-based livelihoods, responsible travel, natural and cultural heritage. Learners observe the situation, identify evidence, explain relationships, consider consequences and apply the learning to a new context without reproducing textbook wording.
